scope: development mechanism study; no formal confirmation or general CLM claim
training_mode: soft only; same checkpoint evaluated with native soft and sparse Top-1 inference
soft_semantics: absorbing STOP; conditional mean of live histories, not exact path enumeration
path_restrictions: self transitions allowed; entry 0; forced termination after four compute steps
minimum_success: for every seed, hard PPL <= 1.01 * global PPL, actual hard matmul FLOPs <= 1.05 * global, inference latency <= 1.05 * global
medium_success: minimum success plus hard PPL <= global and mean sequential hard depth < fixed four-step depth, for every seed
strong_success: for every seed, hard PPL <= global, actual hard matmul FLOPs < global and same-batch inference latency < global
noncollapse: for every seed, at least two distinct sampled hard paths and no single Cell receives >=95% of aggregate hard visits; diagnostic, not proof of semantic specialization
completion: all three models finish exactly 10M tokens; checkpoint step 5000; all routed layers report 32000 validation tokens; final checkpoint evaluation and timing present
aggregation: three paired seeds; report per-seed values, mean and sample SD; every-seed gates; no significance claim
confounds: fixed uses four width-2048 Cells, global and internal use eight width-1024 Cells; total FFN capacity matches
global is parallel Top-2; internal is sequential with STOP; differences do not isolate router location
soft training executes 25 Cell visits per layer, regardless of expected stopping probability
Top-1 quality can degrade after soft training; hard evaluation is not hard-trained quality
GFLOPs estimate excludes dispatch, norms, activation and softmax; inference benchmark is measured separately
bounded validation path samples do not establish semantic task specialization
publication: write preflight before GPU work; append immutable small evidence immediately after each seed, including incomplete or failed; preserve source/protocol/data/file hashes; no checkpoints in git
hardware: two NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs; one concurrent arm per GPU; no distributed training

model_and_training_config.tokenizer: train-split ByteLevel BPE; vocab 8192; EOS between stories
model_and_training_config.training_window_sampling: seeded random windows with replacement; same windows across arms within seed
